blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 能夠定義彈性體組件 (elastomeric components) 的範圍，區分章節適用與不適用的情境
blocks.en: Define the scope of elastomeric components and distinguish where the chapter applies and where it does not

blocks.zh: 理解三層化學適用性評估架構：〈381〉基線篩查 → 〈1663〉可萃取物研究 → 〈1664〉藥品滲出物評估
blocks.en: Understand the three-tier chemical suitability framework: <381> baseline screening → <1663> extractables studies → <1664> assessment of leachables from drug products

blocks.zh: 掌握 Type I 和 Type II 彈性體組件的分類原則及其對藥品選材決策的影響
blocks.en: Understand the classification principles for Type I and Type II elastomeric components and how they affect material selection for drug products

blocks.zh: 了解間接接觸 (indirect contact) 的概念，及其對範圍界定的實務意義
blocks.en: Understand the concept of indirect contact and its practical significance for defining scope

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Elastomeric Components（彈性體組件）：俗稱「橡膠零件」，包括瓶塞、活塞（plunger）、針頭護套（needle shield）等，是注射用藥品包裝系統中最關鍵的材料之一。
blocks.en: Elastomeric components: commonly called "rubber parts", they include vial stoppers, plungers, needle shields and similar items, and are among the most critical materials in injectable drug packaging systems.

blocks.zh: Thermoset（熱固性）vs Thermoplastic（熱塑性）：
blocks.en: Thermoset vs thermoplastic:

blocks.zh: 熱固性（如傳統丁基橡膠瓶塞）：成型後無法再加熱軟化，化學交聯網絡固定，相對穩定但含有硫化劑、促進劑等可萃取物
blocks.en: Thermoset (for example, conventional butyl rubber stoppers): cannot be softened again by heating after molding; the chemically cross-linked network is fixed. Relatively stable, but contains extractables such as vulcanizing agents and accelerators

blocks.zh: 熱塑性（如 TPE）：可重新加熱成型，通常添加劑較少，被認為萃取物風險較低，但機械性能可能不同
blocks.en: Thermoplastic (for example, TPE): can be reheated and reshaped; usually contains fewer additives and is considered to carry a lower extractables risk, but its mechanical properties may differ

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 〈381〉 的三層測試架構就像蓋房子的地基、結構、裝修三個階段：
blocks.en: The three-tier testing framework of <381> is like the three stages of building a house: foundation, structure and finishing:

blocks.zh: 〈381〉基線篩查 = 地基測試（這塊土地能蓋房子嗎？最基本的安全確認）
blocks.en: <381> baseline screening = foundation test (can this plot of land support a house? The most basic safety confirmation)

blocks.zh: 〈1663〉可萃取物研究 = 結構設計（這個材料在特定條件下會釋放什麼？量化風險）
blocks.en: <1663> extractables studies = structural design (what will this material release under defined conditions? Quantifying the risk)

blocks.zh: 〈1664〉滲出物評估 = 真實居住測試（在實際產品中測量真實滲出量，最終確認）
blocks.en: <1664> leachables assessment = real-occupancy test (measuring actual leachables in the real product, as the final confirmation)

blocks.zh: 三個階段缺一不可，且必須按順序進行。
blocks.en: None of the three stages can be skipped, and they must be performed in sequence.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 「使用者的責任」是 〈381〉 的重要哲學——章節明確指出，可萃取元素測試的需求評估及測試方法的建立，是使用者（user）的責任，而非 USP 提供統一方法。這反映了監管機構認為藥廠（或 CDMO）必須根據自身產品特性做出科學判斷，而非機械套用標準。
blocks.en: "User responsibility" is an important philosophy of <381>. The chapter states explicitly that assessing the need for extractable elements testing and establishing the test methods is the responsibility of the user, rather than USP providing a single universal method. This reflects the regulators' view that a drug manufacturer (or CDMO) must make a scientific judgment based on the characteristics of its own product, rather than apply a standard mechanically.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼「單一測試策略」無法完全確認彈性體組件的適用性？哪些屬性可能被單一測試遺漏？
blocks.en: Why can a "single-test strategy" not fully confirm the suitability of an elastomeric component? Which attributes might a single test miss?

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 收到新客戶的凍乾注射劑配方，客戶要求使用現有的丁基橡膠塞。你需要完成哪些測試才能確認這個塞子是否適用？
blocks.en: A CDMO receives a lyophilized injectable formulation from a new client, and the client asks for the existing butyl rubber stopper to be used. Which tests do you need to complete to confirm that this stopper is suitable?

blocks.zh: 2. Scope — 適用範圍
blocks.en: 2. Scope

blocks.zh: 直接接觸 vs 間接接觸 (Direct vs Indirect Contact)：
blocks.en: Direct vs Indirect Contact:

blocks.zh: 直接接觸：組件表面直接與藥品接觸，例如西林瓶的瓶塞底面、預充式注射器的活塞
blocks.en: Direct contact: the component surface touches the drug product directly, for example the underside of a vial stopper or the plunger of a prefilled syringe

blocks.zh: 間接接觸：組件本身不接觸藥品，但其滲出物可透過其他材料遷移至藥品中。例如多層瓶蓋內層橡膠（不接觸藥品），但化學物質可透過外層 LDPE 薄膜遷移至瓶內液體
blocks.en: Indirect contact: the component itself does not touch the drug product, but its leachables can migrate to the drug product through other materials. For example, the inner rubber layer of a multilayer closure does not contact the drug, but chemicals can migrate through the outer LDPE film into the liquid in the container

blocks.zh: 間接接觸的概念是 〈381〉 的關鍵擴展——不能因為「沒有直接碰到藥品」就免除測試義務。
blocks.en: The concept of indirect contact is a key extension in <381>: the testing obligation cannot be waived simply because the component "does not touch the drug directly".

blocks.zh: 直接/間接接觸的區別就像裝食物的包裝：直接接觸是塑膠袋直接裝食物；間接接觸是外層紙箱的墨水透過塑膠袋滲入食物。雖然墨水沒有「直接碰到」食物，但它仍然可能汙染食物——這就是為什麼間接接觸也要測試。
blocks.en: The difference between direct and indirect contact is like food packaging: in direct contact, a plastic bag holds the food directly; in indirect contact, ink from the outer carton seeps through the plastic bag into the food. Although the ink never "directly touched" the food, it can still contaminate it, which is why indirect contact also needs to be tested.

blocks.zh: Chapter 〈382〉 過渡條款：功能適用性測試（Functionality Tests，即穿刺力、碎屑等）目前在 〈381〉 中，但未來將移交給新章節 〈382〉 管理。在 〈382〉 完全實施前，仍需按 〈381〉 要求執行。CDMO 廠的 SOP 需要追蹤這個過渡時間表。
blocks.en: Chapter <382> transition provision: Functionality tests (that is, penetrability, fragmentation and so on) are currently in <381> but will in future be transferred to the new chapter <382>. Until <382> is fully implemented, they must still be performed as required by <381>. A CDMO's SOPs need to track this transition timeline.

blocks.zh: 範圍外但「可以適用」：API 製造用容器的橡膠組件雖在章節範圍外，但「may be applied」——意味著監管機構或客戶可能要求你自願適用這些標準。這是灰色地帶，需要在品質協議中明確約定。
blocks.en: Outside the scope but "may be applied": Rubber components of containers used for API manufacturing are outside the scope of the chapter, but "may be applied", which means a regulator or client may ask you to apply these standards voluntarily. This is a gray area and needs to be agreed explicitly in the quality agreement.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 廠收到客戶提供的多層鋁塑瓶蓋（flip-off cap with multilayer liner），其中彈性體層不直接接觸藥品但可能有遷移風險。按照 〈381〉 的間接接觸定義，這個彈性體層在章節範圍內，需要執行相應的理化和生物反應性測試，即使它不是「藥瓶塞」。在包材審核時（packaging material qualification）需要主動識別此類情況。
blocks.en: A CDMO receives a flip-off cap with multilayer liner from a client, in which the elastomeric layer does not contact the drug product directly but may pose a migration risk. Under the definition of indirect contact in <381>, this elastomeric layer is within the scope of the chapter and requires the corresponding physicochemical and biological reactivity testing, even though it is not a "vial stopper". Such cases need to be identified proactively during packaging material qualification.

blocks.zh: 一個用於大輸液袋（IV bag）的橡膠注射口（injection port）是否在 〈381〉 範圍內？
blocks.en: Is a rubber injection port on a large-volume IV bag within the scope of <381>?

blocks.zh: API 原料藥廠用於儲存桶的橡膠墊片，不符合 〈381〉 範圍。但如果你的客戶要求你依照 〈381〉 測試，你應該如何回應？
blocks.en: A rubber gasket used on a storage drum at an API manufacturing site is outside the scope of <381>. But if your client asks you to test it according to <381>, how should you respond?

blocks.zh: 3. Test Samples — 測試樣品
blocks.en: 3. Test Samples

blocks.zh: 表面處理（Surface Modifications）的種類與影響：
blocks.en: Types and effects of surface modifications:

blocks.zh: Siliconization（矽化處理）：塗覆矽油，降低摩擦係數，廣泛用於預充式注射器活塞。矽油本身需要評估對蛋白藥物的影響（可能引起蛋白聚集）
blocks.en: Siliconization: application of silicone oil to reduce the coefficient of friction; widely used on prefilled syringe plungers. The silicone oil itself needs to be assessed for its effect on protein drugs (it may cause protein aggregation)

blocks.zh: Chlorinated surface（氯化表面處理）：以氯氣處理表面，減少藥品萃取物，但改變表面化學性質
blocks.en: Chlorinated surface: surface treatment with chlorine gas to reduce extractables into the drug product, but it changes the surface chemistry

blocks.zh: Fluoropolymer coating（氟聚合物塗層）：如 Flurotec®，在橡膠表面形成惰性薄膜，大幅降低萃取物，常用於高風險藥品（如蛋白藥、脂質製劑）
blocks.en: Fluoropolymer coating: for example Flurotec®, which forms an inert film on the rubber surface and greatly reduces extractables; commonly used for high-risk drug products (such as protein drugs and lipid formulations)

blocks.zh: 測試樣品必須代表「最終完成品」，包括所有製造步驟和表面處理後的狀態。這意味著你不能用未經矽化的橡膠塞來代替矽化橡膠塞進行測試——表面處理會改變萃取物輪廓。在實驗室研究階段使用的樣品規格，必須與最終商業產品一致，否則驗證結果無效。
blocks.en: Test samples must represent the "finished product", including the state after all manufacturing steps and surface treatments. This means you cannot substitute a non-siliconized stopper for a siliconized one in testing, because surface treatment changes the extractables profile. The sample specification used in laboratory studies must be identical to that of the final commercial product, otherwise the validation results are invalid.

blocks.zh: 如果一個橡膠塞在開發階段是「未塗層」的，但商業產品將使用「氟聚合物塗層」版本，開發階段的測試結果能否用於商業申報？
blocks.en: If a stopper was "uncoated" during development but the commercial product will use a "fluoropolymer-coated" version, can the development-stage test results be used for the commercial filing?

blocks.zh: 矽化處理對蛋白藥物（biologic）的影響是什麼？為什麼預充式注射器的矽化方式（噴塗 vs 烘烤）對產品穩定性很重要？
blocks.en: What is the effect of siliconization on protein drugs (biologics)? Why does the siliconization method for prefilled syringes (spray-on vs baked-on) matter for product stability?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 〈381〉 為注射用包裝/給藥系統中彈性體組件的基線化學與生物反應性要求，需配合 〈1663〉 可萃取物和 〈1664〉 滲出物研究形成完整的化學適用性評估框架
blocks.en: <381> sets out the baseline chemical and biological reactivity requirements for elastomeric components in injectable packaging/delivery systems, and must be combined with <1663> extractables and <1664> leachables studies to form a complete chemical suitability assessment framework

blocks.zh: 範圍包含直接接觸與間接接觸（透過遷移影響藥品）的所有彈性體組件；API 製造用容器的橡膠組件超出範圍但可自願適用
blocks.en: The scope covers all elastomeric components in direct contact and in indirect contact (affecting the drug product through migration); rubber components of containers used for API manufacturing are outside the scope but may be applied voluntarily

blocks.zh: 測試樣品必須是完成所有製造步驟和表面處理（矽化、氯化、氟聚合物塗層等）後的最終完成品，以確保測試結果具有代表性
blocks.en: Test samples must be the finished product after all manufacturing steps and surface treatments (siliconization, chlorination, fluoropolymer coating, etc.), so that the results are representative

blocks.zh: 功能適用性測試目前在 〈381〉 中，待 〈382〉 完全實施後將移交；使用者有責任評估可萃取元素測試的需求並建立適合的測試方法
blocks.en: Functionality tests are currently in <381> and will be transferred once <382> is fully implemented; the user is responsible for assessing the need for extractable elements testing and establishing suitable test methods
